select sum(a.sl) from (select count(1) as sl from tb_material_details where type_id = #{id} and del_flag = '0' union all select count(1) as sl from tb_material_item where type_id = #{id} and del_flag = '0' union all select count(1) as sl from tb_material_type where up_id = #{id} and del_flag = '0') as a

WITH RECURSIVE numbers AS ( SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM numbers WHERE n < #{pdz} ) SELECT n AS missing_num FROM numbers LEFT JOIN (select CONVERT(replace(material_code, #{upCode}, ''), SIGNED) as code from tb_material_type where up_id = #{upId} and del_flag = '0' and organ_code = #{organCode}) t ON numbers.n = t.code WHERE t.code IS NULL ORDER BY n limit 1
